info.name: IntroVox
info.summary: Guided tours for Nextcloud and its apps
info.description:
IntroVox shows people around Nextcloud. New users get a welcome tour after their first login, and a short tour the first time they open an app such as Files, Talk, Deck or Calendar.
**For users:** * A welcome tour after the first login, in their own language * Short tours the first time they open an app or a page, or a tip on any page after a few days * Steps that go on when they click the element or fill in a field; a step whose element is not there yet waits aside until it appears * Images, GIFs and videos in steps, with descriptions and captions * Every tour can be started again from the personal settings, also through Tours in the user menu, and tours that start by themselves can be switched off * An optional "Getting started" checklist on the Dashboard that ticks itself off
**For administrators:** * Built-in tours for Files, Talk, Deck and Calendar, and tours of your own for an app, a page, or anywhere * Translated default steps via Transifex (every translated language is available automatically), with your own steps per language where you want them * Groups per step and per tour * Who gets a tour and when: everyone or new accounts only, a number of days after the first login, between two dates * Share links that start a tour, for a welcome mail or a message to a team * Statistics per tour: how many people started, completed and skipped it, and how far people get * Export and import of a whole tour, with its steps in every language and its images and videos * Translate a tour or write its steps with AI, through the Nextcloud Assistant; you check every step before it is saved * Optional anonymous telemetry reporting * Automatically adapts to your Nextcloud theme (light, dark, high contrast)
Built with Vue 3 and Shepherd.js.
info.author: Rik Dekker
